3.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1TRANSPOINT_00473_OPEN_000_000
3.description: You have attuned yourself to an Aethernet shard and now have access to the region's Aethernet.
3.translation_description: Sintonizzandoti con un frammento dell’Eternet, ottieni accesso alla rete Eternet della regione.

4.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1TRANSPOINT_00473_OPEN_000_001
4.description: Additional shards can be found throughout the Forbidden Land, Eureka. Attune to them to facilitate faster travel throughout the island.
4.translation_description: Puoi trovare altri frammenti nella Terra Proibita, Eureka. Sintonizzati con ciascuno per spostarti più rapidamente sull’isola.
